form.name: Contract Name
form.nameInfo: Descriptive name for this contract. Used in reports and the renewal calendar.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional description of the contract scope...
form.referenceNumberInfo: The contract or reference number assigned by the supplier, if any.
form.internalIdInfo: Auto-generated unique identifier for internal reference.
form.supplierInfo: The vendor or service provider this contract is with.
form.locationInfo: The branch or office that is the contracting party.
form.kindInfo: Classification of this agreement. Drives validation rules and the recurrence engine.
form.billingCycleInfo: How often recurring charges are generated (e.g. 1 month).
form.dateEndInfo: Date the contract expires. Leave blank for open-ended.
form.autoRenewInfo: If enabled, the contract automatically renews when it expires.
form.renewalNoticeDaysInfo: Number of days before expiry to flag the contract as Expiring.
form.currencyInfo: ISO 4217 currency for all financial fields on this contract.
form.committedAmountInfo: Total value committed at signing. Immutable after approval.
form.cycleAmountInfo: Expected charge per billing cycle for recurring contracts.
form.paymentTermsInfo: Agreed payment schedule with this supplier.
form.rejectionReasonPlaceholder: Explain why this contract was rejected...
form.expenseAccountInfo: GL account to debit when expenditures post against this contract.
form.accrualAccountInfo: GL account to credit for accrued but unpaid charges.
form.expenditureCategoryInfo: Category for roll-up reporting and budget tracking.
form.notesInfo: Internal remarks only. Not visible to the supplier.

confirm.bulkDeleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete the selected contracts? This action cannot be undone.
